item.title: Migrating a Website? Don't Lose Pages: Extract Every Sitemap URL in Seconds
item.description: Before you migrate, redesign or audit a website, save every page URL. This free Google Sheets tool extracts every URL from any sitemap or sitemap index in seconds.

item.title: Thousands of Pages, No Idea Which Are Indexed? Check Them All at Once, Free
item.description: Stop inspecting URLs one by one in Search Console. This free Google Sheets tool checks the index status, last crawl, canonicals and rich results of up to 2,000 URLs a day.

item.title: Can't Afford Semrush? This Free SEO Audit Tool Gives In-Depth Results in 10 Minutes
item.description: No budget for Semrush or Screaming Frog? This free SEO audit tool crawls up to 5,550 pages inside Google Sheets and gives you a health score, broken links and quick wins in about 10 minutes.

item.title: Stop Copy-Pasting GSC and GA4 Data: Automate Your SEO Reports in One Google Sheet
item.description: Stop exporting Search Console and GA4 data by hand. This free Google Sheets tool builds your SEO report automatically, with insights, comparisons and scheduled emails.
